invariants.rationale: The return value is produced by calling a method, so 'result' is very likely never null.
The method returns metadata.clone(...), producing a new object, so 'result' should not be the same object as 'metadata'.
Both 'result' and 'metadata' are HoodieWriteMetadata objects, likely of the same type.
Result's statuses are returned as a List according to the method signature (HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>).
The method calls collectAsList() on metadata.getWriteStatuses(), so it must not be null.
